A1.justification: Both nine-page PDFs describe DCT-Shield and have readable text, equations, figures and tables. Both end with references and omit their referenced supplementary sections, limiting comparison of appendix-dependent methods, experiments and results.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-editing, inpainting, human-evaluation and purification-robustness results in Tables 1–2 and Figures 3–8.

after.justification: v2 retains original quantitative, qualitative and human-evaluation results for image editing, inpainting and purification robustness.

M1.justification: The JPEG/DCT pipeline, VAE latent-norm objective, projected gradient descent and base, masked and Y-channel variants remain unchanged. The revised channel selection for the inpainting experiment concerns configuration of these existing variants.

E1.justification: Both retain 150 OmniEdit samples and 56 inpainting samples from PPR10K and web portraits. v2 newly mentions cross-model transfer and Gaussian-noise, IMPRESS and noisy-upscaling tests, but the missing supplements prevent establishing whether these represent added coverage or newly described existing experiments.

E2.justification: Corresponding visible comparisons retain PhotoGuard, MIST, AdvDM and SDS(-), with DiffusionGuard additionally evaluated for inpainting. IMPRESS is mentioned as a purification condition, without an added defense-comparator result.

E3.justification: Section 5.3 changes the reported inpainting model from Stable Diffusion v1.5 Inpainting to Stable Diffusion Inpainting 1.0; Section 6.2 changes masked noise from Y-only to YCbCr. Section 6.1 removes DCT limit 0.6 and changes baseline budgets from 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 to 10, 12, 14, 16 (/255), matching the unchanged Figure 5. These are reported-setting revisions; reruns are not established.

E4.justification: Figure 5's sensitivity analysis and the visible JPEG, crop-and-resize and AdvClean robustness analyses are retained. v2 additionally points to supplementary purification and cross-model-transfer analyses in Sections D.3 and D.5, whose absence prevents verifying additions or revisions.

E5.justification: Figure 8 retains identical error bars. The supplied text adds no run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests or explanation of uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–2 and plotted results in Figures 5, 7 and 8 are unchanged. The unchanged inpainting scores accompany revised reported settings, so they establish no same-setting performance change. Possible supplementary robustness and transfer-result additions cannot be checked.

T1.justification: Section 4.2 corrects the formal domain of quantized coefficients from real-valued to integer-valued tensors and restricts the perturbation bound to positive reals. These are limited formal corrections; the optimization and supporting reasoning remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract and central contributions retain the same claims about imperceptible DCT-domain protection, JPEG robustness, specialized variants and encoder-based parameter efficiency. Rewritten contribution and conclusion passages preserve their scientific scope.

C2.justification: The protection–imperceptibility trade-off, encoder-efficiency explanation and claimed robustness above the chosen JPEG quality threshold are retained. The revised JPEG discussion clarifies the existing interpretation without introducing substantive limitations or failure conditions.

D1.justification: The reproducibility description revises the inpainting model/channel specification and comparison-budget grid. Default quality 0.95, perturbation bound 1, step size 0.1, 1000 iterations and 512×512 resolution remain unchanged. Added supplementary pointers provide no inspectable implementation details in these files.

R1.justification: v2 adds the IMPRESS reference. Sections 2 and 4.2 redirect citations from Liu et al.'s Diff-Protect to Xue et al.'s score-distillation paper; Section 4.2 still names Liu et al., creating an attribution inconsistency. The broader research positioning is retained.

P1.justification: Local edits polish contribution, method, JPEG-robustness and conclusion passages, clarify attack terminology through a footnote, standardize naming and update supplementary references. The main section order and overall narrative structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 6 is slightly reduced, figures and text reflow, and some qualitative images change compression or resolution. All eight figures and both tables retain their organization and examples; the quantitative plots are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 fixes the demonstrable mismatch between Section 6.1's budgets and Figure 5 and improves several explanations. However, revised inpainting settings accompany identical results without explaining whether these are corrections or reruns, newly referenced empirical support is unavailable, and the Liu/Xue attribution becomes inconsistent. These mixed changes prevent a reliable net quality judgment.
